scope: Characterize all five author-selected Voyager1 signal stamps from one previously observed GBT scan. Metadata already inspected; no power values inspected before saving this scope.

search.endpoint_shift_channels: integer eighths from -8*(nchan-1) through +8*(nchan-1); deduplicated nearest-neighbour time-index sequences
search.statistic: sum of original float32 powers in float64, minus sum of each row's median
search.normalization: No variance/SNR/FAP calibration; subtracting per-row median is a constant for every fully supported trace.
search.tie_break: first in ascending endpoint shift then ascending start column
search.reference_comparison: Stored hit frequency/rate/SNR are selected reference measurements, not ground truth or independent validation.

outputs: stamp_0.npy through stamp_4.npy preserve every original value
limitations: One historical 2016 GBT observation of a known human transmitter; not new observing time.
Source is preselected hit-stamps, not raw unselected telescope observation.
No ON/OFF sequence or new SETI candidate.
The five stamps are related carrier/sideband structures, not five independent observations.
Rate scan is local to small stamps and finite support; excluded paths have no coverage claim.
No promotion of original BA survey authority or original closed failures.
